svg.text: no upstream build, distributions only; no optimizations

g.title: libpq - blue (critical) Release: Ubuntu Gap: Build Farm: 3 active riscv64 workers, last run 2026-08-26, all passing; no GitHub Actions riscv64 jobs; distros provide binaries
psycopg - green (optional) Release: upstream Gap: py3-none-any wheel (pure Python) + riscv64 binary wheels on PyPI; CI tests via QEMU weekly
pgx - green (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Pure Go, no assembly, no CGo; runs on linux/riscv64 by construction via Go toolchain
pgjdbc - green (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Pure-Java Type 4 JDBC; single arch-independent JAR on Maven Central
MariaDB Connector/C - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: No riscv64 CI; Ubuntu noble ships libmariadb3 riscv64; connector builds from unmodified upstream source
go-sql-driver/mysql - green (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Pure Go, no assembly/CGo; runs on linux/riscv64 by construction
MariaDB Connector/C - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: Same project as MySQL layer entry; Ubuntu noble ships libmariadb3; connector builds from unmodified upstream source
go-sql-driver/mysql - green (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Same project as MySQL layer entry; pure Go; runs on linux/riscv64 by construction
hiredis - yellow (critical) Release: Ubuntu Gap: CI covers x86/arm/aarch64 but no riscv64 job; Debian sid 1.2.0-6+b4 (rv-osuosl-02), no riscv64 patches
PostgreSQL - blue (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Build Farm: 4 active riscv64 workers on master through REL_13_STABLE; zero GitHub Actions riscv64 jobs; source-only upstream tarballs

MySQL - orange (critical) Release: Debian (Ubuntu) Gap: No upstream riscv64 CI; Ubuntu 24.04 ships 8.0.36 with use-largest-lock-free-type-selector-on-riscv.patch; Debian sid removed 8.0; mysql-9.7 missing riscv64 build
MariaDB - yellow (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI (.gitlab-ci.yml 564 lines, zero riscv refs); all 17 Debian patches lack riscv64-specific changes; RocksDB plugin disabled on riscv64

Redis - orange (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 references across all 9 upstream CI workflows; Debian sid ships 5:8.0.6-2; PRs #15204 (Zbb popcount) and #15273 (HyperLogLog RVV) unreviewed since May 2026

Valkey - orange (optional) Release: Debian Gap: CI covers x86_64, x86-32, macOS ARM64 only; no riscv64 runner or QEMU job; no upstream release binary assets; Debian sid ships valkey-server 9.1.1-1 for riscv64
KeyDB - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: CI covers ubuntu-latest/ubuntu-20.04/macos-latest/libc-malloc only; empty release assets; no distro packages; manually buildable per community report

Dragonfly - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: Zero riscv64 CI across 20 workflows; no riscv64 assets in releases v1.38.0-v1.40.1; FATAL_ERROR in helio/cmake/internal.cmake requires manual CMake override
Memcached - yellow (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Upstream CI single x86_64-only job; Debian sid 1.6.45-1 (rv-osuosl-03); all packaging patches generic
pgvector - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: Zero riscv64 CI; Ubuntu 24.04 ships 0.6.0, Debian sid ships 0.8.6, unpatched upstream; scalar fallback fully functional
PostGIS - yellow (optional) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI; Woodpecker covers arm64/armhf/s390x but not riscv64; Debian sid 3.6.4+dfsg-2, no riscv64 patches
TimescaleDB - yellow (optional) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI; upstream releases Windows amd64 only; Debian sid 2.29.2+dfsg-1 ships riscv64, single non-arch patch
Apache AGE - yellow (optional) Release: Debian Gap: All 5 upstream workflows x86_64 only; Debian ships postgresql-18-age 1.8.0~rc0-2 for riscv64, no arch-specific patches
Citus - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: All 7 workflows x86_64 only; no riscv64 package in any downstream distro or PGDG
Patroni - green (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Pure Python; py3-none-any wheel on PyPI v4.1.5; runs on riscv64 by construction
PgBouncer - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: No riscv64 CI upstream; Debian ships 1.25.2-1 (rv-osuosl-01); no riscv64-specific packaging patches
Pgpool-II - yellow (optional) Release: Debian Gap: No upstream CI of any kind; Debian sid ships pgpool2 4.7.2-1 (rv-manda-04); single generic config patch
pgcat - red (optional) Release: none Gap: ring 0.16 build-blocking dependency (riscv64 support added in 0.17); upgrade PR #881 open unmerged; no CI, no distro packages
Vitess - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: No riscv64 CI across ~49 workflows; release v24.0.2 ships only amd64/x86_64; no distro packages
ProxySQL - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: No riscv64 CI; v3.0.11 ships only x86_64/aarch64; coredumper unconditional dep; jemalloc 5.2.0 rejects riscv64gc triple
RocksDB - orange (optional) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI; Debian carries patch removing build-blocking #error in toku_time.h; upstream PR #14530 open unmerged
MyRocks - orange (optional) Release: Debian Gap: No upstream riscv64 CI; MDEV-29875 open/critical (jemalloc mm_malloc.h scope issue); Debian carries riscv64-specific workaround patches
MariaDB ColumnStore - red (optional) Release: none Gap: .drone.jsonnet targets only amd64 and arm64; not packaged in Debian, Ubuntu, or Arch Linux RISC-V; no known riscv64 build attempt
Galera Cluster - yellow (optional) Release: Debian Gap: Upstream CI x86 only; Debian sid ships galera-4 26.4.27-1 (rv-manda-02, 2026-08-10); no riscv64-specific patch applied
MaxScale - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: No CI of any kind (.github/ has only dependabot.yml); no riscv64 binary from any channel
RediSearch - orange (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: No riscv64 CI; Ubuntu ships v1.2.2 (7 major versions behind upstream 2.10.x); VectorSimilarity has no riscv64 cmake flags
RedisJSON - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: No riscv64 CI; no release artifacts; bindgen pin resolved (upgraded to 0.66.1 in 2025-12-30) -- no confirmed current breakage
RedisBloom - red (optional) Release: none Gap: Makefile contains explicit $(error) for any arch other than x64/arm64v8; deprecated since Redis 8 GA (May 2025)
RedisTimeSeries - red (optional) Release: none Gap: Makefile contains hard $(error) on riscv64; vendored cpu_features v0.6.0 emits CMake FATAL_ERROR for riscv64; effectively archived
mcrouter - red (optional) Release: none Gap: mcrouter/lib/Clocks.cpp hits #error Unsupported CPU at compile time; folly has two open riscv64 build failures (#2493, #2416)

CloudNativePG - red (optional) Release: none Gap: continuous-delivery.yml hard-codes PLATFORMS: "linux/amd64,linux/arm64"; v1.30.0 releases cover x86_64/arm64/ppc64le/s390x only; zero riscv64 issues or PRs
Zalando postgres-operator - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: All CI workflows run ubuntu-latest; platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64 hard-coded; no riscv64 in any release or distro
postgres_exporter - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: promci/build cross-compiles; test_go and integration_tests run x86_64 only; ships postgres_exporter-0.20.1.linux-riscv64.tar.gz
Percona Operator for MySQL - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: CI builds only linux/arm64 and linux/amd64; no riscv64 Docker image on Docker Hub
MySQL Operator for Kubernetes - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: build.sh contains ^(amd64
mysqld_exporter - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: test_go on ubuntu-latest only; promci/build cross-compiles; ships mysqld_exporter-0.20.0.linux-riscv64.tar.gz
mariadb-operator - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: .goreleaser.yml lists goarch: [amd64, arm64] only; latest release v26.6.0 has only linux_amd64 and linux_arm64 tarballs
Redis Operator (OT-CONTAINER-KIT) - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: publish-image.yaml hard-codes platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64; ci.yaml builds only amd64/arm64
redis_exporter - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: v1.90.0 ships 23 Linux arch assets; riscv64 absent from all; no CI references; pure Go but upstream has never shipped riscv64 binary
memcached_exporter - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: promci/build cross-compiles; test_go on amd64 only; ships memcached_exporter-0.17.0.linux-riscv64.tar.gz

Kubernetes - yellow (optional) Release: Debian Gap: No upstream riscv64 CI (zero Prow riscv64 nodes confirmed); no upstream release binaries; Debian sid kubectl 1.33.4+ds-1, no riscv64-specific patches; open PR #141291 (pause image, on hold)

containerd - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Nightly CI cross-compiles riscv64; ships riscv64 tarballs in every release; integration test workflow has zero riscv64 entries; PR #13124 unmerged
runc - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: Publishes signed runc.riscv64 in every release (v1.5.1 confirmed); zero riscv64 occurrences in all three CI workflow files

etcd - orange (optional) Release: Debian Gap: No upstream riscv64 CI; no riscv64 assets in v3.7.1 (July 2026); Debian carries two riscv64-specific patches (startup gate removal; InitialMmapSize reduction from 10 GB to 16 MB)
Helm - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: goreleaser cross-compiles riscv64 and publishes at get.helm.sh for every release (v4.2.4); unit tests run x86_64 only
k0s - blue (optional) Release: none Gap: riscv64.yml runs unit tests + 2 smoke tests on native RISE Scaleway EM-RV1 runners, all passing; release v1.36.3+k0s.2 ships no riscv64 binary
k3s - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: No CI riscv64 build; v1.33.13+k3s2 has zero riscv64 assets; cluster cannot start due to missing container images; PR #7778 closed 2026-08-10 without merging

Prometheus - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: build_all job cross-compiles riscv64 and publishes tarballs (since v2.46.0) and Docker images (since v3.10.0); zero riscv64 entries in any test job
node_exporter - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: promu crossbuild on x86, zero test execution; ships node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-riscv64.tar.gz

OpenTelemetry Collector - yellow (optional) Release: upstream Gap: cross-build-collector job cross-compiles with no test step; Tier 3 platform per platform-support.md; publishes riscv64 tarball/.deb/.rpm/Docker in v0.159.0

Grafana - yellow (optional) Release: Alpine Linux Gap: release-build.yml includes riscv64 with allow-failure: true; absent from PR gate; no upstream release artifact; Alpine edge ships grafana 12.4.4-r1

Grafana Alloy - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: build.yml lists only amd64/arm64/ppc64le/s390x; v1.19.2 (2026-08-26) has zero riscv64 assets; issue #1036 closed not_planned; PR #1526 closed unmerged
OpenSSL - blue (critical) Release: Debian Gap: cross-compiles.yml runs `make all tests` via qemu-user on every push; source-only upstream tarballs
BoringSSL - yellow (optional) Release: none Gap: CQ-gated LUCI builders cross-compile on every commit with run_unit_tests: false and run_ssl_tests: false; no binary releases
zlib - blue (critical) Release: Ubuntu Gap: others.yml runs both cmake --build and ctest for riscv64 (OpenBSD/riscv64 via QEMU); source-only upstream releases
zlib-ng - blue (optional) Release: Alpine Linux Gap: cmake.yml and configure.yml run ctest/make test on QEMU riscv64 (GCC + Clang); RVV paths in arch/riscv/ for all primary hot paths
LZ4 - yellow (critical) Release: Ubuntu Gap: CI runs live compress/decompress under qemu-riscv64-static; LZ4_FAST_DEC_LOOP disabled; 5 RVV PRs open unmerged; optimization level minimal

zstd - yellow (critical) Release: Debian Gap: CI runs full test suite at rv64gc and with RVV vlen=128/256/512; Huffman 4-way loop disabled (PR #4622 open); sequence decode scalar fallback (PR #4557 open); Zicclsm absent (PR #4596 open)

snappy - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: CI runs `make test` via QEMU on every push; V128 byte-shuffle decompression fast path absent; CRC32 hash has no riscv64 equivalent; PR #233 closed without merge

jemalloc - orange (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI; Debian ships 5.3.1-2 from unpatched source; HAVE_CPU_SPINWAIT=0 on riscv64; zero RVV/RISC-V assembly; absent-optimization cap overrides yellow distro floor
tcmalloc - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: No riscv64 CI; TCMALLOC_PERCPU_RSEQ_SUPPORTED_PLATFORM=0 on riscv64; per-CPU RSEQ slab entirely absent; only slower per-thread fallback available
PCRE2 - blue (critical) Release: Debian Gap: dev.yml ptarmigan job runs ctest in QEMU riscv64 container on every push to main (updated 2026-08-09); source-only upstream releases
ICU - yellow (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI across all six major workflows; Debian sid libicu78 78.3-2 ships riscv64 with no riscv64-specific patches; pure scalar C++
libevent - yellow (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Zero riscv64 CI across all four workflow files; Debian sid ships 2.1.13-stable-1 from unmodified upstream source; both patches are arch-agnostic

liburing - yellow (optional) Release: none Gap: ci.yml cross-compiles and installs for riscv64 but never executes binaries or calls `make test`; all releases are source-only; Debian/Ubuntu/Arch RISC-V ship from unpatched upstream

libnuma - blue (optional) Release: Debian Gap: All NUMA syscalls resolve via generic kernel headers; no riscv64-specific patches; Debian sid ships libnuma1 2.0.19-1+b2 on rv-osuosl-03; Ubuntu 24.04 also ships libnuma-dev for riscv64
Protocol Buffers - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: Zero riscv64 CI; no riscv64 protoc in release v36.0; Ubuntu 24.04 ships libprotobuf-dev 3.21.12 with no riscv64-specific Debian patches
Lua - yellow (optional) Release: Ubuntu Gap: Pure ISO C99, no arch-specific code; Ubuntu 24.04 ships lua5.4 5.4.6-3build2 riscv64; Debian packaging has only two non-arch-specific patches

xxHash - blue (optional) Release: upstream Gap: ci.yml runs make check plus RVV consistency checks at vlen 128/256/512; RVV backend covers all three XXH3 primary hot paths with adaptive-vlen intrinsics; no riscv64 binary upstream
glibc - green (critical) Release: Debian Gap: Both Sourceware Buildbot riscv64 builders offline; Debian sid libc6 2.43-4 ships riscv64 with no riscv64-specific patches

libmvec - orange (optional) Release: none Gap: libmvec does not exist for riscv64 in upstream glibc; no Linux distro ships riscv64 libmvec; psABI PR #455 merged 2026-06-18 removes one blocker but no implementation patch submitted
